## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any related issue.

## Validation

List commands or browser checks actually run and their results. Mark anything that remains unverified, including the browser, operating system, language and build used when relevant.

- [ ] Relevant syntax, unit, documentation and build checks pass, or omissions are explained.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and translations are updated.
- [ ] Permission, storage, privacy and version changes are explained when applicable.
- [ ] Generated builds, browser profiles, credentials and personal data are excluded.

## Risks and recovery

Describe material compatibility or data risks and how to reverse the change, if applicable.
